title: Return to Dust
summary: Lei Daozi finds Wang Ping and the Immortal Guard protecting him and moves to seize the peak Illusory Yin puppet, until Wang Lin arrives and drags him off to the wastes of Planet Ran Yun. Lei Daozi's lightning cannot hurt Wang Lin, whose Life and Death domain has quietly reached Ascendant great perfection, and Wang Lin's Thunder Beast terrifies Lei Daozi's young lightning beast, but Lei Daozi's Second Step origin power still outmatches mere arts. Looking for a weak spot, Lei Daozi reveals that Wang Ping's flesh no longer exists and his soul is held together by Nirvana sword qi, then uses his Origin Lightning Cauldron. Wang Lin breaks out with the third seal of the God Slaying War Chariot and cuts him down with the Net-Severing Sword. Wang Ping finally understands why he could never cultivate, never have children and never fall ill in seventy years, thanks his father for a full life and fades away. Qing Yi chooses to follow him into death, and Wang Lin is left with memories of the son who once said the medicine was bitter.
